profile.subtitleJa: 青銅職人の母が属した部族として記される。
profile.summaryJa: 列王記上7:14は、青銅職人の母がナフタリ族に属していたと記します。
profile.identityNoteJa: 列王記上7:14で名指されるのは、母の出自としてのナフタリ族です。族祖ナフタリ本人やナフタリ地方を指す表現とは分けて読めます。

wikipedia.title: Tribe of Naphtali
wikipedia.noteJa: 英語版記事は、ナフタリ族をイスラエル十二部族の一つとして説明しています。

sources.title: World English Bible (WEBP), 1KI 7:14, fixed witness webp-usfx-2026-10-13-35a6adf626e5
sources.attribution: World English Bible (WEBP), public domain; pinned local witness webp-usfx-2026-10-13-35a6adf626e5; Japanese prose is an editorial paraphrase.

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: He was the son of a widow of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a worker in bronze; and he was filled with wisdom and understanding and skill to work all works in bronze. He came to King Solomon and performed all his work.

occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 「in Naphtali」は行政区域を指す。部族集団の明示用法ではないため、集団プロフィールへ含めない。
occurrenceChecks.text: Ahimaaz, in Naphtali (he also took Basemath the daughter of Solomon as wife);

occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 本文は青銅職人の母を「the tribe of Naphtali」の出身と明示する。族祖本人の行為ではなく部族集団の用例。
occurrenceChecks.text: He was the son of a widow of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a worker in bronze; and he was filled with wisdom and understanding and skill to work all works in bronze. He came to King Solomon and performed all his work.

occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 「all the land of Naphtali」は領域を指すため、部族集団プロフィールから除く。
occurrenceChecks.text: Ben Hadad listened to King Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel, and struck Ijon, and Dan, and Abel Beth Maacah, and all Chinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali.

review.identityCheckJa: 同じ名が4:15では地方、7:14では部族、15:20では領地を指す。プロフィールは明示された部族集団の7:14用法のみを表す。

wikipediaBodyRead.title: Tribe of Naphtali
wikipediaBodyRead.supportJa: Lines 140 says the Tribe of Naphtali was one of the twelve tribes of Israel; this supports the collective subject, not the patriarch or the exact 1KI 7:14 family.
wikipediaBodyRead.observedExcerpt: The Tribe of Naphtali was one of the northernmost of the twelve tribes of Israel.

review.remainingUncertaintyJa: WEBの7:14は部族への所属のみを述べる。個別の領域位置や族祖本人の伝記はこの用例からは導かない。
